body:
## Context
Issue #829: In `plugins/adlc-gemini/hooks/adlc-rails-guard.mjs`, when a tool call carries no file paths (such as `run_command`), `runFromStdin` resolves the tracking root via `resolveWorkspaceRoot(payload, env)` and `findAdlcRoot(transcriptPath, env)`. In `--print`/headless mode, `workspacePaths` is empty, the hook process `cwd` is the plugin directory outside the repo, and `transcriptPath` lives under `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/brain/<id>/...` outside the repo, so `findAdlcRoot(transcriptPath)` returns `null`. `runFromStdin` then falls back to `process.cwd()` (the non-ADLC plugin directory), so pathless calls never increment the repository session depth counter in `.adlc/sessions.json`. Meanwhile `preInvocation` and `onStop` already fall back to `discoverRootFromTranscriptRecords(parseTranscriptRecords(transcriptPath))`.

## Scope
- `plugins/adlc-gemini/hooks/adlc-rails-guard.mjs`
- `plugins/adlc-gemini/test/build-gate.test.mjs`

## Changes Required
1. In `plugins/adlc-gemini/hooks/adlc-rails-guard.mjs`:
   - Check `env?.WORKSPACE_ROOT` alongside `AGY_WORKSPACE`, `ANTIGRAVITY_WORKSPACE`, `GEMINI_WORKSPACE`, `PROJECT_ROOT`, `INIT_CWD`, and `PWD` in `resolveWorkspaceRoot`.
   - Extract absolute path tokens from `cmd` in `runFromStdin` when `distinctRoots.size === 0 && isShell && cmd` and resolve their ADLC root via `findAdlcRoot`.
   - In `runFromStdin` and `postToolUse`, when `distinctRoots.size === 0 && transcriptPath`, if `findAdlcRoot(transcriptPath, env)` is `null`, fall back to `discoverRootFromTranscriptRecords(parseTranscriptRecords(transcriptPath, { readFull: true }), env)`.
   - Avoid adding a non-ADLC `process.cwd()` fallback to `distinctRoots` when `findAdlcRoot(repoRoot, env)` is null.
2. Add unit tests in `plugins/adlc-gemini/test/build-gate.test.mjs` covering pathless `run_command` depth tracking with empty `workspacePaths` and a non-repo `process.cwd()` via `WORKSPACE_ROOT`, command path extraction, and transcript record discovery.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Pathless `run_command` tool calls advance the repository persistent depth counter in `--print`/headless mode when `workspacePaths` is absent/empty.
- Verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-gemini/test/build-gate.test.mjs`
title: plugin(adlc-gemini): resolve pathless tool call tracking root in headless/--print mode (#829)
